_comment: Example only. Replace every host with your own. notify_email has no default and never will: an alerting tool that ships with an address in it mails a stranger.

domains._why: Marketing site. A bare 200 is not enough: a suspended deployment and an empty build both return 200. The marker is a string that only the real page contains.
API root 404s by design, so probe the health path and read the field that proves the database is actually attached.
Nested field, substring match: status can be 'ok' or 'ok (degraded)'.
Behind HTTP auth. 401 is the correct answer from a healthy host, so allow it or this alerts every day.
Redirect to the apex. Default status check accepts any 2xx or 3xx.

The homepage can be fine while every signed-in action fails. Declare the exact signature of that break: this one returned 403 with 'csrf' in the body after an origin misconfiguration, while / kept serving 200.
